description.value:
You swear to protect one person, and the oath sharpens you against whatever threatens them.

Choose one ally during your daily preparations; they are the target of your Vow until your next preparations. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against any creature that has damaged the target of your Vow, or attempted to inflict a condition on them, since the end of your last turn.

Additionally, once per round when the target of your Vow would be reduced to 0 Hit Points while you are within 30 feet, you may use a reaction to Stride up to your Speed toward them. If this brings them within your reach, they remain at 1 Hit Point instead. A given ally can be saved this way only once per hour.

Special You may have only one Vow at a time. Deliberately breaking a Vow — abandoning the person you swore to protect — costs you the use of this feat until you complete a full day of atonement.
